definition: Named AI system/tool used or discussed, separate from input–output modality.
Stage/activity of AI use: early ideas, prompting, critique or presentation.
Produced text, images, diagrams, models or process records.
AI-attributed benefit/teaching function: exploration, critique, feedback or communication.
Reported/anticipated concerns: learning, judgment, authorship, access or design quality.
Student generation, selection, interpretation, questioning or revision of AI contributions.
Teacher guidance, critique, support or assessment of AI-supported design work.
Input–output form: text-to-image, image-to-image or text-to-text.
